items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 36:1
items.html: All the phases that the reflected light clothes from the screen upward, upon the lights of the Rosh, it brings once again, at the time of its expansion from the screen downward, to the ten Sefirot of the Guf as well, and not the least thing is lacking. Therefore this reflected light that descends from above downward is entirely like a “seal”: everything that is engraved upon it, it transfers to that which is imprinted from it, which are the ten Sefirot of the Guf. And in this way from every upper one to its lower one, as is known. (Chapter 8, Item 9, and Inner Light, Item 8)
